integrity: All displayed constants follow from exact algebra applied to stated source theorems. The verification script is corroborative; the proof of uniqueness is analytic. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result optimizes the sufficient coefficient obtained from the general Lemma 6.12 lower bound and Theorems 3.5-3.6; it does not claim an exact spectral gap for analysis sizes other than the source's instantiated case, nor an information-theoretically optimal tolerant-separation constant.
title: Twelve analysis registers optimize a bosonic Gaussian soundness certificate
